question: India has second largest ______ network in the world, aggregating to about 62.16 lakh km (2020–21).
solution:
The correct answer is __**road.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• India has the **second largest road network **in the world, which is about **62.16 lakh km** long.
 
• The Indian road network is just behind the** United States** in terms of length.
